subject: English
passage: The Okavango Delta in Botswana was designated a Wetland of International Importance under the Ramsar Convention in 1997, a title that ______ that the delta harbors an ecologically rich habitat worthy of protection.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. In this context, 'signifies' means indicates or denotes. The sentence states that the Okavango Delta was designated a Wetland of International Importance under the Ramsar Convention and that this title represents the fact that the delta harbors an ecologically rich habitat worthy of protection. The title thus signifies — points to or indicates — the delta's ecological value.
